Definition: Mehetabel, the name of an Edomitish man and woman
BiblicalUsage: Mehetabeel or Mehetabel = "favoured of God"; n pr m; 1) the ancestor of Shemaiah, the false prophet who was hired against Nehemiah by Tobiah and Sanballat; n pr f; 2) the daughter of Matred and wife of king Hadad of Edom
